title: Alcohol use disorder: severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's alcohol use, if any is reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for alcohol use.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y.o. male presenting for follow-up regarding alcohol use. Pt admits to ongoing daily consumption, reporting 4-5 drinks per day. He notes difficulty reducing intake despite previous attempts. Pt expresses frustration with lack of progress but remains currently drinking. No acute physical complaints reported today.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily.

Exam
Pt is alert and oriented x3. Appears well-nourished. Speech is clear and coherent. RRR, CTAB, WNL. No acute distress noted.

Assessment
1. Alcohol use disorder, severe. Pt continues to consume alcohol daily despite counseling.

Plan
1. Discussed risks associated with continued use. Pt advised to attend outpatient support group meetings. 
2. Provided resources for local community programs.
3. Pt to f/u in 4 weeks to monitor progress and reinforce harm reduction strategies.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Alcohol use disorder, moderate or severe, indexes to alcohol dependence: F10.20 (HCC 139).

distractors.why: Moderate or severe use disorder is dependence (F10.2-); abuse has no HCC.
A use disorder with a severity is documented.

hccs.label: Alcohol Use Disorder/Moderate/Severe/Alcohol Use with Specified Non-Psychotic Complications
